results.title: Russia's exclusion from senior curling competitions extended until end of year
results.description: World Curling says Russia will remain excluded from senior international curling events through the end of the year, citing risks to competition integrity and the position of most member federations.

results.title: US Senate votes to extend AGOA trade programme for 32 African nations
results.description: The United States Senate has approved a two-year extension of the African Growth and Opportunity Act, maintaining duty-free access on more than 1,800 products from eligible countries.
